reviews.comment: Extremely biased in how he grades. Disappointing.

I loved taking DWS, look if you don't want to do critical thinking then don't take him. He definitely promotes critical thinking and wants you to speak up during class for input or if you don't understand something. Not an easy A, but if you like to use your brain and challenge yourself then he's a great prof for that. Good person too.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Serrano came in to my COMM 243 class at the end of the semester after my orig prof had to step away. He had the best intentions and just wanted us to have fun at the end of the semester. He graded and organized our final debate. He loves debate and teaching it. He was an awesome prof for the time he taught 243

Professor Wanzer-Serranos public speaking class was not difficult whatsoever but at times could be tedious. A lot of busy work was assigned weekly which helped with grades. The speech projects were what a majority of your grade counted on. My only major complaint is that he didnt offer much feedback on the speeches or speech assignments.
Quizzes and discussion are not that hard but the test were really hard and I went to every class.

Created a positive atmosphere before you enter class, but during class it was disappointing. He is definitely well-versed in his field of work, but there is a time and place to use exclusively "expert vocabulary." That time is not with a class of inexperienced college students. It was like he was trying to prove something rather than teach us.
DWS is a cool guy and i really tried to like him all semester. However, at the end of the semester I don't and I think his class was the most difficult class I've ever taken in my life.

This class is tough. The content itself is hard to understand but DWS doesnt help at all. He basically expects you to be on his level of understanding for material that youve never seen before. Theres not mandatory attendance but if you dont watch every lecture you will not pass, even if you go to every lecture you still might not pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Constantly changed due dates and had due dates set during my other classes. Was not understanding of anything that may happen in you life, which is discouraging given covid. Did not want students to succeed, and that was evident in his course structure. Prof WS, how can you care so little about your students, and call yourself a teacher?

Prof. Wanzer has made my last semester at Texas A&M a challenge. Every week he assigns 2 readings that are around 30 pages long. These goes over the different forms of rhetoric and how they can be analyzed. Not only are these papers hard to follow, but Prof. Wanzer does an exceptionally HORRIBLE job at explaining the topics. Attending class/Pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: this guy was one of the worst professors ive ever had. he seemed to like the fact that we were all struggling and didnt seem to care if we had questions. he made ridiculously hard tests and didnt care that majority of the class was confused 99% of the time. terrible prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Quizes were once a week (one questions) - I got 100 on all of them. Lectures were hard to understand and grasp but this is a very difficult course. We had 3 test that were hard. He did say he was making them harder because the average was "too good" on the first exam. He means well, I just don't think he know how hard material is for undergrads.

Wanzer is not a terrible professor. Anybody who has taken this course has told me that it is very hard to grasp and the material is not easy, it's a rhetoric class. Due to Covid, he used youtube for lectures which I really liked. Class wasn't mandatory but you need to go and read the articles (which are crazy long). I liked the structure of class.

One of the hardest classes and professors. I never missed a class or reading. His lectures are heavy and doesn't explain the material in a way students can understand. His exams are SO hard, he even stated he wanted a 10% passing rate because he was used to students not passing. His aesthetic is cool though. Would not take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Save yourself the time and stress. If him saying that we did too well on the first exam and that he needed a lower test avg. doesn't scare you then idk what will. Each lecture gets harder to listen to. Material is dry and difficult to interpret and comes from long essays that translate into the exams.

Professor Wanzer is all charisma, which makes this hard. The problem is he never dissects the material in a manner to help you understand it. The class is a barrage of very long and dense articles, followed by lectures to explain, but his explanations are just as long and dense. All tests are from these lectures and you only get those once.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not. I repeat DO NOT take this class. This guy was a psychopath. Did not understand 98.999% of the words that came out of his mouth. LOTS of reading, and the essays he gives to read are EXTREMELY difficult to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He makes you read at least 20 pages for each article that are very hard to read, then his lectures will confuse you even more. He is very rude in answering questions, basically just says it was in the reading or straight up says, "I'm not going to answer that." Also, a quiz every class period that weighs a lot. Do not take this professor!
